item_specifications.special_feature: Easy to Clean, Non Skid Bottom, Orthopedic, Removable Cover, Water Resistant

about_item: Foam Balances Comfort & Support: Uniquely contoured foam combines plush softness with firm support, evenly distributing your dog's weight to relieve joint pressure and promote deeper, more restful sleep. Accomodates most dog sizes.

Full-Coverage Bolster for Head & Neck Support: Slimmer front edge flows into a plush, thicker back to cradle the neck, while soft PP cotton fill delivers a snug, wrapped feeling that soothes and secures.
All Season Feather-Soft Comfort: The sleeping surface is lined with ultra-soft fleece that calms restlessness and stays comfortable through every season.

Stylish & Home Decor Friendly: A corduroy outer cover adds a clean, modern look that blends with any decor. Built-in waterproof lining protects the foam from accidents, and a non-slip bottom keeps the bed in place.
Low-Temp Wash & Dry: Unzip and remove the bottom foam insert for machine wash and tumble dry on low. (Note: side foam is fixed and not removable.)

authors_reviews.title: Initially pleased!
authors_reviews.text: We purchased two of these beds (size Large) for our Boston Terrier pups. We are trying to get them out of our bed at night so we wanted to get beds large enough for them to stretch out on. When I got the first one opened and put it on the floor, our larger pup immediately jumped in and stayed there while we assembled the 2nd bed. Our initial thoughts are that they are a great size. Our bigger pup is 30lbs and the smaller is 25lbs for reference. The size is great.Since we only just got them I do not know how durable they are, but it was easy to assemble them and the cover does come off so they can be washed and that’s really great. The only thing that concerns me is the bolster on top is attached to the cover so idk how that will hold up in the wash. My dogs are still not keen on the idea of sleeping in their own beds though hahaha!
authors_reviews.author: April

authors_reviews.title: Great bed especially for older dogs with bad joints!
authors_reviews.text: My dog laid on it instantly when I show it to him. I was kind of confused how it came in 2 zip lock things and not together but I ended up putting a trash bag around the foam pad to make it “water proof” and it seemed to make it easier to zip the cover on. It also helps if u fold the foam pad like a taco :) but yes definitely recommend he loves it and I tried it out myself it’s very comfy and the thickness of it is nice definitely an upgrade from the small thin bed I had. My dogs 8 so I’m happy knowing his joints will have less pressure on them while he’s relaxing/ sleeping.
